Definition: properly, to sever oneself, i.e. (by implication) to be dislocated; figuratively, to abandon; causatively, to impale (and thus allow to drop to pieces by rotting)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to be dislocated, be alienated; 1a) (Qal) to be dislocated, be torn away, be alienated; 1b) (Hiphil); 1b1) to execute slowly (by exposure or impalation); 1b2) to hang; 1c) (Hophal) to be executed
